selectedSpans.quote: A proposition P is true, and P implies Q. Applying that implication yields Q.

theorem result (P Q : Prop) (hp : P) (hpq : P → Q) : Q := by
  exact modusPonens P Q hp hpq

explanation: This is direct implication application: hp supplies P and hpq maps P to Q. The Lean result delegates to modusPonens with exactly those assumptions.

interpretations.meaning: Modus ponens for arbitrary propositions P and Q.
interpretations.qualification: No alternate method or hidden premise indicated.

evidence.detail: Static source-to-proof correspondence: modusPonens applies hpq to hp, matching the stated inference. No reviewer Lean execution.

omissions: No independent Lean execution; proof-term correspondence is direct.
